data.name: Liminal Agent
data.detailed_description:
Explore massive interconnected liminal spaces inspired by dreams, forgotten places, and the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms. Wander through abandoned shopping malls, endless highways, underground tunnels, retro fast food restaurants, empty cinemas, surreal hotels, and impossible spaces that should not exist.

Liminal Agent has 4 chapters and every chapter introduces new environments, hidden paths, entities, and psychological horrors designed to make you feel lost, isolated, and constantly observed.

Chapter 1 

  Descend into diverse variations of Level 0 and other unstable backrooms environments filled with unnatural silence and shifting spaces.

Chapter 2 

   Explore abandoned shopping malls and empty cinemas where reality slowly begins to break apart.

Chapter 3 

   Travel through endless tunnels, deserted highways, retro restaurants and the disturbing chaos of Level Fun.

Chapter 4 

  Enter a massive liminal hotel where every corridor feels familiar.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from around 2016 or later
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 or newer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen 7 from 2018 or later
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or newer
